// Package shapes is a fixture covering most of Go's syntax.
package shapes

import "fmt"

import (
	"errors"
	str "strings"
	_ "embed"
	. "math"
)

const Pi2 = Pi * 2

const (
	KindA Kind = iota
	KindB
	_
	KindC = 1 << iota
)

var (
	ErrEmpty       = errors.New("empty")
	count    int64 = 0x1F_ff
	ratio          = 1.5e-3 + 0x1p-2 + 0o17 + 0b1010 + 2i
	raw            = `raw
string\n`
	r1, r2 = 'x', 'é'
)

type Kind int

type Shape interface {
	Area() float64
	fmt.Stringer
	~int | ~float64
}

type Number interface {
	~int | ~int64 | float64
}

type Pair[K comparable, V any] struct {
	Key   K `json:"key"`
	Value V `json:"value,omitempty"`
	*Embedded
	fmt.Stringer
	a, b int
}

type Alias = map[string][]*Pair[string, int]

type Fn func(int, ...string) (bool, error)

type Ch struct {
	in  <-chan int
	out chan<- int
	bi  chan struct{}
	arr [4]byte
	dyn [...]int
}

func Sum[T Number](xs ...T) (total T) {
	for _, x := range xs {
		total += x
	}
	return
}

func (p *Pair[K, V]) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%v=%v", p.Key, p.Value)
}

func (Kind) Method() {}

func run(ch chan int, done <-chan struct{}) (err error) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("panic: %v", r)
		}
	}()
	go func(n int) { ch <- n }(1)
	i := 0
	i++
	i--
	i <<= 2
	i &^= 1
	x := &i
	*x = -*x + ^i
	ok := !(i > 2 && i <= 5 || i != 3)
	_ = ok
outer:
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		switch {
		case i%2 == 0:
			continue outer
		case i > 7:
			break outer
		default:
			fallthrough
		case i == 5:
			goto end
		}
	}
	for {
		break
	}
	for range 3 {
	}
	for i < 3 {
		i++
	}
	select {
	case v, ok := <-ch:
		_, _ = v, ok
	case ch <- 2:
	case <-done:
		return nil
	default:
	}
	switch v := any(i).(type) {
	case int, int64:
		fmt.Println(v)
	case nil:
	}
	switch k := Kind(1); k {
	case KindA:
	}
	if v, err := strconv(); err != nil {
		return err
	} else if v > 0 {
		return nil
	} else {
		panic("unreachable")
	}
end:
	s := []int{1, 2, 3}[1:2:3]
	m := map[string]Pair[string, int]{"a": {Key: "a", Value: 1}}
	p := Pair[string, int]{"b", 2, nil, nil, 0, 0}
	_ = s[:]
	_ = s[1:]
	arr := [...]string{0: "a", 4: "e"}
	_, _, _ = m, p, arr
	f := func(a, b int) int { return a + b }; _ = f
	y := make([]int, 0, 10) /* block
	comment */
	z := new(int) // line comment
	_ = append(y, *z)
	_ = str.ToUpper(raw)
	var w struct{ A int }
	_ = w.A
	_ = Sum[int](1, 2)
	return
}

func strconv() (int, error) { return 0, nil }
